verdict.rationale: Trace and log sampling and retention-tier controls are a fair question for an observability platform like Datadog. However, the evidence pack contains only page titles for APM [datadog-docs-23] and Log Management [datadog-docs-13], with no content describing sampling rules, ingestion controls, or retention tiers. Community comments about log storage pricing describe cost, not a volume-control capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately
